summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.16/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.16 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 22, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 2¢ higher than a week ago, 21¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.41 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.94) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.46).
